crossRefs.note: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews…
All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people…
Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for…
It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf…
In every province, and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy…
Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a…
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at…
Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples, and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come;
But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison!…

translations.web: Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
translations.bsb: As for those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
translations.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
translations.asv: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
